note: Read by eye from the W79 space-accounting floor plans (levels 0 to 10), with the tower names from the building: A is the west tower, B the middle one, C the east tower by the lobby. A section is the part of a floor that is connected, named by level and towers (3AB and 3C are the two sections of the 3rd floor). Edit this file, then run: bun run floorplan Elevators run directly between sections and share one service per tower, so flagging one ride blocks that whole elevator. Hidden sections are only passed through. Places on a floor are listed in the order given here, so list rooms from the entrance outward (floor 1 runs from the lobby at the east end toward the dining hall). towerOrder lists the towers nearest the main lobby first; when two routes cost the same, the nearer tower wins.

entrances.name: Main Lobby Entrance
entrances.in: Come in through the lobby doors at the east end of the building, next to the C elevator.
entrances.out: Leave through the lobby doors at the east end of the building.

rooms.name: Mailbox Lounge (156)
rooms.in: Walk to the lounge by the mailboxes, room 156.
rooms.out: Leave the mailbox lounge and return to the lobby area.

rooms.name: Dining Hall (food service 144/145/166)
rooms.in: Follow the corridor to the dining area (food service rooms 144, 145 and 166).
rooms.out: Leave the dining area and return to the corridor.

elevatorSkips.why: The A elevator does not open onto floor 1 for students.

stairSkips.why: Only the C stairs are usable on floor 1.
Only the C stairs are usable on floor 1.
